items.text: Eagles situation getting worse. Will be without three of their most important players vs Rams: DeVonta Smith, Dallas Goedert, Zack Baun.
Tough runout for Jadarian Price: lost GL/base to Emmanuel Wilson, pass work to George Holani, back-to-back fumbles, chest hurt, Charbonnet back at practice. Passes eye test long-term though.
Jaylen Warren on LOVE list as top-10 play; 90% snaps last week, 20/22 RB touches with Dowdle out; CLE allows 88+ rush yds every game.
Omarion Hampton on Hate list; low utilization (RB27), 3.5% target share, 25% routes, snap rate down to 42%, only 13% third-down; SEA allows 2.9 YPC.
